# Travelated

> > Travelated is a global hotel search and accommodation booking platform covering destinations across the Caribbean, South America, Europe, Africa, and beyond.

Travelated provides comprehensive hotel listings and travel guides for destinations worldwide, with particular coverage of Caribbean locations like Haiti, South American regions including the Colombian Amazon, and international destinations across multiple continents. The platform offers multilingual support and detailed accommodation search capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Hotel search and reservations
- Caribbean travel (Haiti, Cap-Haïtien)
- South American accommodations (Colombia, Amazonas)
- Beach resorts and coastal destinations
- Amazon River region lodges
- European destinations (Faroe Islands)
- North African hotels (Tunisia, Tunis)
- Cultural heritage sites (Citadelle Laferrière, Sans Souci Palace)
- Jungle and eco-lodges
- Multilingual booking platform
- Travel guides and destination information
- Atlantic Ocean and Mediterranean destinations
- Regional accommodation listings
- Customer support and travel assistance

## Caribbean Destinations

- [Nord hotels. Best hotels in Nord, Haiti](https://www.travelated.com/haiti/nord): Hotel listings for Nord, Haiti featuring Cap-Haïtien and beach resorts

## South American Destinations

- [Amazonas hotels. Best hotels in Amazonas, Colombia](https://www.travelated.com/colombia/amazonas): Hotel search for Amazonas, Colombia including Leticia and jungle lodges

## European & International Destinations (French)

- [Îles Féroé hôtels. Meilleurs hôtels en Îles Féroé](https://www.travelated.com/fr/iles-feroe): French: Faroe Islands hotel listings covering Streymoy and Eysturoy
- [Hôtels du gouvernorat de Tunis. Meilleurs hôtels du gouvernorat de Tunis, Tunisie](https://www.travelated.com/fr/tunisie/tunis): French: Tunis Governorate hotels with Mediterranean accommodation options
